rules: THC-dataset remains the source of truth for reviewed scientific claims referenced through datasetClaimSha256.
An encyclopedia evidence record may reference an upstream reviewed claim but must not copy or redefine its review state.
Only upstream claims with review_state=approved, citation_verified=true, rights_state=reviewed, and rag_eligible=true are eligible for reviewed-claim binding.
Scope and limitations from the upstream claim must be preserved when translating evidence into lesson prose.
A dataset binding does not authorize encyclopedia publication; lesson publication controls remain independent.
